traits.name: Light-fingered
traits.description: Steals more often, but finds 25% more loot.

traits.name: Honest
traits.description: Rarely steals, but honest work costs 10% more.

traits.name: Loyal
traits.description: Starts more loyal and loses half as much loyalty when unpaid. Asks 5% more.

traits.name: Mercenary
traits.description: 15% cheaper, but loyal only to coin: getting paid doesn't raise their loyalty.

traits.name: Veteran
traits.description: Arrives two levels above the party, and wants 30% more for it.

traits.name: Coward
traits.description: Arrives Cowardly, but works for 30% less.

traits.name: Tough
traits.description: +2 Constitution, and charges 10% more for it.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.description: +2 Might, -1 Sense. Charges 10% more.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: +3 Luck, and charges 10% more for the privilege.

traits.name: Haggler
traits.description: Talks the cleric down: heals and blessings cost the party 25% less.

traits.name: Pious
traits.description: A blessing gives them +20 extra loyalty.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.description: +20% damage and asks 10% more. -10 loyalty after a won fight where they didn't land a kill.

traits.name: Union Rep
traits.description: If they go unpaid, everyone else loses 5 more loyalty.

traits.name: Gambler
traits.description: +1 Luck. Their wage is rerolled every night: 50-150% of normal.

traits.name: Drunkard
traits.description: Works for 20% less. After payday, 30% chance they fight hungover the next day (-30% damage).

traits.name: Nephew of the Queen
traits.description: Can't be fired or seized, and the Queen's tribute is 10% lower while they serve. A little spoiled.

traits.name: Medic
traits.description: Potions heal 50% more, and a paid party rests 10% more overnight.

traits.name: Glory Hound
traits.description: +10% damage. +5 loyalty for winning a high-risk job, -5 on rest days.

traits.name: Bookworm
traits.description: Helps with the books: audits are 15% more likely to catch a thief. -1 Might.

traits.name: Frugal
traits.description: Works for 15% less and is a little less greedy, but skips meals: -1 Constitution.
